description: List the subscribers of one mailing list filtered by status (Subscribed, Unsubscribed, Bounced or Removed), with name, email, custom fields, tags, preferences and dates. Paged. Moosend: GET /lists/{MailingListID}/subscribers/{Status}.json.

mailing_list_id.description: Mailing list ID (a GUID, from moosend_list_mailing_lists).

status.description: Subscriber status to return. Default Subscribed.

name: moosend_list_subscribers
title: List subscribers in a list
